name: Purposes
overview: Scripture reveals that God's purposes are sovereign, intentional, and unfailing, as He declares the end from the beginning and accomplishes all that pleases Him (Isaiah 46:10; 55:11). Believers are assured that God perfects what concerns them and does not abandon His handiwork (Psalms 138:8). Christ's mission to seek and save the lost (Luke 19:10) and to give abundant life (John 10:10) aligns with God's overarching plan, in which all things work together for good to those called according to His purpose (Romans 8:28).
